name: Julie
source:
The Special Research Officer of the Anti-Meteora organization, Prometheus, and the scientific genius who designed the underground city. This mad scientist has lived over two hundred years in her entirely cybernetic body.

A reclusive researcher, she does not often show herself on the city streets, but her contributions to the urban world cannot be underestimated.

She created Chloe, her masterpiece, through a long process of DNA manipulation with the sole purpose of fighting the Meteoras. She has a great interest in the Meteoras as subjects for her research and often pushes the members of Prometheus toward the difficult task of capturing them.
